scopeNotes.serviceReach: Read-only API responses confirmed the customer organisation matches the existing HELP project. The assigned service was linked to HELP through the agent UI; no project organisation or settings changed.
scopeNotes.fixtures: Only the assigned P5 service/release fixtures were changed. Release notes were edited, released/published for the checks, name edited after publication to verify snapshot stability, then unpublished. The workspace feature override was restored to its original inherited state.
scopeNotes.screenshots: Published list and detail screens cover 390, 768 and 1440 widths in light and dark themes using user-preferences state. All recorded layouts have no horizontal overflow.
scopeNotes.axe: No axe browser runtime was available; visual/semantic checks used Playwright accessible roles and headings.

screenshotReadinessAttempt.error: Capture stopped before all 12 screenshots; previous screenshot evidence retained.

screenshotReadiness.detail: Screenshots were recaptured on persisted SIT after waiting for the customer portal sidebar. At widths 768 and 1440, both Home and Release notes sidebar links were visible before capture. At width 390, the sidebar was opened and both links verified, then closed before capture. Fonts and two animation frames settled before each screenshot.
